svg.title: RIEMANN-MASULLO-DIAGRAMS M1 — What the seven target theorems rest on
svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: each of the 7 theorems comparator.json names rests in Lean on 1 open declaration, traceFormula_exteriorZeros, the recorded gap for Theorem 12.5.1.1. Everything else below them is proved. Read from the elaborated terms, not from the paper.

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. A declaration rests on another when its type or proof term names it, directly or through other declarations: the closure riemann-masullo's own scripts/progress/Deps.lean reads from the compiled library at 72a10ff. An open declaration is one whose term

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: uses sorryAx: 16 of the 21,342 declarations of the library, Statements.lean and Main.lean are. This is a fact about the Lean. The Lean states repaired forms where the print is wrong, so the paper's own argument may lean on the step differently.

svg.text: Together they rest on 1,513 declarations of the project and 92 vendored ones (AlgebraicNumberTheoryLean, under RiemannMasullo/External/), which are counted here and not drawn. The permitted axioms are propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice (comparator.json).
